# Synthetic publication acceptance target

This directory belongs only to the draft QA acceptance target. These synthetic functions are not imported by application code or run as tests. The target head deliberately removes a zero-count guard and adds a zero-divisor defect, for precise OLD/NEW inline anchors and real Git rename coverage.

Neither branch is proposed for merge. Creating this draft PR does not authorize a bot COMMENT; that external write requires approval for the exact PR and an existing authorized bot runner. No real model quality claim is made. Refs API #24/#27.
